reviews.body:
## Code Review

This pull request fixes an issue where 'getDocFromServer' drops server-only fields when a 'setDoc' merge is pending and the document is not yet in the local cache. This is resolved by preserving the patch mask for uncached remote documents in 'applyToLocalDocumentSet', allowing merge mutations to be correctly applied as patch overlays. Consequently, the tracking of 'docsWithoutRemoteVersion' has been removed, simplifying both 'localStoreWriteLocally' and 'applyToLocalDocumentSet'. A new unit test has been added to verify this behavior. Feedback on the changes suggests a minor refactoring in 'localStoreWriteLocally' to simplify the promise chain by avoiding the temporary 'remoteDocs' variable.
